FIELD REFERENCE

Mahi-mahi (dorado): identification and Florida trip rules

Mahi-mahi is Coryphaena hippurus, the saltwater fish also called dorado, dolphin or dolphinfish. It is not a marine mammal. Look for a long dorsal fin and blue-green and gold colours. Before an offshore trip, check the fishing area: Florida Atlantic and Gulf state waters have different size and bag limits.

Plan the next step: Florida fishing licences · Florida Keys trip timing · Other mahi-mahi name records.

Updated 2026-11-24 · Castward

Key factDetail

Are dorado, dolphin and mahi-mahi the same fish?

For this saltwater species, yes. Texas Parks and Wildlife uses all three names for the same fish. The word dolphin can also mean a marine mammal, so ask for the scientific name when the context is unclear. A trip description should name the fish, the water and the departure port.

Read the source

How can you tell a male mahi-mahi from a female?

NOAA describes a square forehead on adult males and a rounded forehead on females. Both have bright blue-green, gold and silver colouring. Colour fades quickly after harvest, so use body and head shape as well. The related pompano dolphinfish is a different species; colour alone does not separate them.

Read the source

Which Florida mahi-mahi limits apply to a charter?

Choose the fishing area before applying a limit. In Atlantic state waters, FWC lists five fish per customer on a for-hire trip and a 20-inch fork-length minimum. Captain and crew cannot retain a bag limit. Gulf state-water limits differ. Ask the captain to confirm any federal-water rules for the route.

Read the source

When should you plan a Pacific mahi-mahi trip?

California Sea Grant describes year-round catches in its Pacific fishery profile. That broad window does not establish a local peak month or guarantee a boat can sail. For a holiday trip, compare the port, travel month and weather policy before choosing a boat; keep a spare day if possible.

Read the source

Is mahi-mahi good to eat, and how should you choose it?

California Sea Grant describes firm, moist flesh and a mild flavour. Its seafood profile also separates the fishery and harvest method when discussing environmental concerns. Check where the fish came from instead of treating every mahi-mahi fishery alike. For a fishing trip, arrange cold storage before you decide to retain a legal catch.

Read the source

What should you know about mahi-mahi?

Is mahi-mahi a dolphin mammal?

No. Dolphinfish is a fish; the shared common name causes the confusion.

Is dorado always this species?

Use Coryphaena hippurus for the saltwater fish on this page. A common name alone is not enough to identify a fish.

How large do mahi-mahi grow?

NOAA gives a maximum of almost 7 feet and 88 pounds. That maximum does not describe an average charter catch.

Is the Florida limit the same on both coasts?

No. The table separates Atlantic and Gulf state waters. Check federal waters separately.

Can the captain keep an extra Florida bag limit?

FWC prohibits captain and crew from retaining a bag limit.

Does year-round availability guarantee a trip can sail?

No. Check the weather, local conditions and current rules for your port and travel dates.
